chapter.verse: Ni guk khit ciangin Jesu in Peter, James leh James' sanggampa John samin amau teng guak mual sang khat ah paitohpih hi.
Tua ciangin amaute' mai-ah Jesu a mel kikhel a, a maitang ni bangin taangin a puante khuavak bangin paak hi.
En un, Moses leh Elijah zong hong kilangin Jesu tawh kiho uh hi.
Peter in Jesu' kiangah, “Topa, hih takah i om pen nuam mahmah hi. Hoih na sak leh buk thum, nang' ading khat, Moses' ading khat, Elijah' ading khat, kong lamsak ding hi,” ci hi.
Tua bangin a pau laitak, en un, a paak silsial meiilum lom khat in amaute tuam a, meii lakpan awging khat in, “Hih pen ka it ka Tapa hi; ama' tungah ka lungkim mahmah hi. Ama' thu na ngai un,” ci hi.
Hih awging a zak uh ciangin nungzuite leilak ah boksuk uh a, nakpi-in lau uh hi.
Ahih hangin Jesu hong pai-in amaute lawng a, “Tho un, lau kei un,” ci hi.
Amaute a daktoh uh ciangin Jesu longal kuamah dang mu lo uh hi.
Mualtung pan a kumsuk uh ciangin Jesu in amaute thupia a, “Tu-a na muhtuamte uh Mihing' Tapa sihna pan a kithawhkiksak mateng kuamah' kiangah gen kei un,” ci hi.
Tua ciangin nungzuite in Jesu' kiangah, “Tua ahihleh bang hangin laisiamte in Elijah hong pai masa ding ci uh ahi hiam?” ci-in dong uh hi.
Jesu in, “Elijah hong pai takpi hi. Amah in na khempeuh bawlhoihkik ding hi.

Ahi zongin ke'n kong cihin ah Elijah hong pai khinzo a, mite in amah ahihlam thei lo uh ahih manin a ututun bawl uh hi. Tua mah bangin Mihing' Tapa in zong mite' khutsung ah gimna thuak ding hi,” ci-in dawng hi.
Tua ciangin Baptizepa John' thu a gen ahihlam nungzuite in tel uh hi.
Mihonpi' omna a tunkik uh ciangin Jesu' kiangah mi khat hong pai-in a mai-ah khukdin a,
“Topa aw, ka tapa hong khual in. Amah sibup natna vei-in gim mahmah hi. Meikhuk sung leh tui sungah muktu thei zel hi.
Na nungzuite' kiang amah ka paipih a, amau damsak theilo uh hi,” ci hi.
Jesu in, “Upna neilo, a lehtat khangmite aw, note bangtanvei kong ompih kul lai ding hiam? Bangtanvei kong thuak kul lai ding hiam? Naupang kei' kiangah hong paipih un,” ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jesu in dawi taai hi. Dawi zong pasalno' sungpan paikhia a, tua hunlenai lianin pasalno dam pah hi.
Tua ciangin Jesu' kiangah nungzuite amau guak hong pai uh a, “Bang hangin kote in tua dawi hawlkhia zolo ka hi uh hiam?” ci-in dong uh hi.

Jesu in hih bangin dawng hi: “Na upna uh neu ahih man hi. Maantak kong cihin ah ankamtang bang upna na neih uhleh hih mual' kiangah, ‘Hih pan hua takah va kikhin in,’ na cih uh ciangin tua mual kin ding hi. Tua hi a, note' ading a piang theilo bangmah om lo ding hi.
(Ahi zongin hih bang namte pen thungetna leh antanna lo tawh paikhia lo hi.”)
Galilee gam ah a omkhop laitakun Jesu in nungzuite' kiangah, “Mite' khut sungah Mihing' Tapa a kilehhek ding hita hi.
Amaute in amah that ding uh a, a ni thum ni-in amah kithokiksak ding hi,” ci hi. Tua ciangin nungzuite a vekun dah mahmah uh hi.
Capernaum khua a tun uh ciangin Peter' kiangah biakinnpi siah a khonte hong pai uh a, “Na syapa in siah pia lo ahi hiam?” ci uh hi.

Peter in, “Pia mah hi,” ci hi. Inn sung a tum ciangin Jesu in amah na hopih masa a, “Simon aw, na bangci ngaihsut hiam? Leitung kumpite in kuate' tungpan siah kai uh ahi hiam? Amau' tate' tungpan hiam, ahihkeileh midangte' tungpan hiam?” ci hi.
“Midangte' tungpan,” ci-in Peter in a dawn ciangin Jesu in hih bangin ci hi: “Tua bang ahihleh amau' tate a peng uh ahi hi.

Ahi zongin amaute a phinbawl i suah loh nadingin tuili ah va pai-in ngakawi tawh ngasa va siah inla hong awk masapen la in. A kam na phen ciangin stater tang khat na mu ding hi. Tua sum la inla kei' aitaang leh nang' aitaang dingin amaute va pia in.”
